retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic 1980s-inspired layout featuring a subject leaning against a massive, three-dimensional initial letter that overlaps secondary bold sans-serif text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a man in 80s attire leaning against a giant, red 3D 'D' which serves as a foreground frame for black, condensed block lettering on a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject physically interacts with the oversized initial letter
Primary red initial overlaps secondary black background text
Repeating ticker-tape text at the top creates a horizontal border
Color coordination between subject's accessories and the primary graphic element
coreInvariants: Oversized 3D letter as the central anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left third, scaled to appear life-sized relative to the giant letter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive red 3D letter 'D' dominates the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the lean into the red letter, then reads the black text behind it.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space surrounds the central composition, focusing attention on the graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (3D letter, scarf, and shoes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against neutral black and white for maximum pop.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the background text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary initial is rendered as a physical 3D object with depth and shadow.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a massive 3D geometric initial with ultra-condensed flat block text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight for the background text.
Good base for the 3D initial letter skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in 80s fashion (grey sweater, black pants, red scarf/shoes) leaning against a large red 3D letter 'D' on a plain white background. Leave space for text behind the 'D'.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed black uppercase text behind the red 'D'. Add a repeating line of small italicized text at the very top. Add a stylized blue-grey title with a drop shadow below the top line.

verificationChecks: Is the subject leaning naturally against the 3D letter?
Is the background text properly layered behind the 3D letter?
Are the red accents consistent across the subject and the graphic?
Is the top ticker-tape text perfectly horizontal?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., change red to yellow)

mustAchieve: Clean 3D extrusion on the main letter

postGenerationChecks: Verify color balance between red and black
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Giant 3D Initial + Layered Condensed Text + High Contrast Palette = 80s Funk Aesthetic
